```typescript
// Initiate the business signup process.
async function signupBusiness(businessName: string, email: string) {
  try {
    const signupResult = await client.business.signup({
      businessName,
      email,
    });
    console.log("Signup initiated:", signupResult);
    return signupResult;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Error initiating signup:", error);
    return null;
  }
}
```

## About This Skill

This skill provides access to Foursquare's internal API — the hidden endpoints that power their web/mobile app.
These are NOT official public APIs. They were captured by observing network traffic while using the site.

**Important:**
- Auth tokens in `auth.json` may expire — re-capture if you get 401 errors
- Internal APIs can change without notice — endpoints may break
- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency

## When to Use This Skill

Use this skill when you need to:
- Access Foursquare data without official API access
- Automate actions on foursquare.com (faster than browser automation)
- Call the same endpoints the Foursquare frontend uses
